caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic vessel, primarily colored in muted brown tones with blue accents. The vessel is oval-shaped with a narrow neck and a slightly flared rim. The neck has an ornamental blue design, and the body features a large, stylized blue flower with visible cross-hatched detailing in the petals and leaves. The flower design is centrally positioned and occupies most of the vessel’s surface. The sides of the vessel are bordered with a scalloped blue pattern that follows the curve of the form. The background is plain and unadorned, off-white in color, emphasizing the vessel as the focal point. There is a small, light pencil inscription near the bottom right of the image.
title: Pa. German Stoneware Flask
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
